project.name: CS-POST-REMAP
project.objective: Remove CellShard's reverse dependency on Cellerator runtime and distributed types while preserving storage, staging, masking, and delivery behavior.

invariants.rule: CellShard owns storage, residency, transport, shard metadata, and neutral device assignment metadata; Cellerator owns execution resources, execution streams, NCCL policy, topology, scheduling, and Cellerator-specific placement.
Do not duplicate Cellerator runtime types in CellShard or hide the cycle behind forwarding headers.
Existing Cellerator-owned format compatibility headers are classified separately from runtime ownership and do not justify a runtime or distributed reverse dependency.

tasks.title: Replace Cellerator runtime coupling with neutral CellShard delivery descriptors
tasks.objective: Refactor CellShard distributed and mask-group APIs so public/runtime code no longer includes Cellerator runtime or distributed headers, names Cellerator runtime types, links Cellerator::dist, or synthesizes that target; preserve compatibility-format headers separately and prove an independent CUDA-enabled CellShard build.
tasks.next_action: Replace local_context and Cellerator::dist use with narrow neutral inputs, remove Cellerator::dist CMake synthesis/linkage, and validate CellShard independently with CUDA enabled.

charter.objective: Remove only CellShard's reverse Cellerator runtime dependency and preserve its storage and delivery semantics.
boundaries: No transfer of NCCL policy or Cellerator scheduling ownership into CellShard.
No redesign of CellShard persistence, artifact, source, identity, or residency foundations.
No duplication of Cellerator runtime abstractions.
acceptance_conditions: CellShard public/runtime source has zero Cellerator runtime or distributed includes and type references.
CellShard no longer locates, synthesizes, or links Cellerator::dist.
An independent CUDA-enabled CellShard configure, build, and focused runtime test pass.
